snippet.text: theorem cartesian_monomial_bound {h : ℝ} (hh : 0 < h) (hh1 : h < 1/2) {f : Inner → ℝ} (hf : ContDiff ℝ ∞ f) (b lo hi : ℝ) {K : Set SpaceTime} (hK : IsCompact K) (m : ℕ) : ∃ C, 0 < C ∧ ∀ z ∈ K, z.1 < 1 → (cartesianChart h z).1 ≤ 1 → (cartesianChart h z).2.1 ∈ Icc lo hi → ‖iteratedFDeriv ℝ m (cartesianMonomial h b f) z‖ ≤ C * (cartesianChart h z).1 ^ (b - m)
